findings.highlight: there aren’t that many houses around
findings.evidenceJa: まわりに家がない
findings.governingReading: there are no houses around us
findings.explanation: The Emiya property’s isolation becomes a merely sparse neighborhood.

findings.evidenceJa: 近所付き合いも少ない
findings.governingReading: we have little contact with any neighbors
findings.explanation: A social relationship pattern becomes the number of people living nearby.

findings.evidenceJa: 切嗣の結界
findings.governingReading: Kiritsugu’s boundary field
findings.explanation: The explicit Kiritsugu referent under Shirou’s “old man/dad” reading loses both name and layered address.

findings.evidenceJa: 藤ねえんところの若い衆
findings.governingReading: one of the young men from Fuji-nee’s household
findings.explanation: The likely visitors’ age, gender, and group relation to the Fujimura household disappear.

findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂の方がピリピリしている
findings.governingReading: Rin is the one bristling with tension
findings.explanation: A visibly taut, irritable state becomes settled anger before she speaks.

findings.highlight: I ask a natural question with my mind blank
findings.evidenceJa: 停止した頭で、当たり前の疑問を言う
findings.governingReading: Inactive narration: with my thoughts stopped, I voice the obvious question
findings.explanation: mirror moon displays a Japanese narration line that is semicolon-commented and therefore inactive in the original script.

findings.evidenceJa: それを簡潔に答えてくる遠坂
findings.governingReading: Inactive narration: Rin answers succinctly
findings.explanation: A second inactive Japanese narration line is restored as displayed English.

findings.highlight: I don’t know why she’s mad
findings.evidenceJa: 怒られる覚えはない
findings.governingReading: I have no recollection of doing anything that warrants being scolded
findings.explanation: Shirou denies any basis for reprimand; the English instead accepts Rin’s anger as fact but says its cause is unknown.

findings.evidenceJa: 気圧されてつい謝る
findings.governingReading: Inactive narration: overawed, I find myself apologizing
findings.explanation: mirror moon displays another semicolon-commented Japanese explanatory line.

findings.evidenceJa: それで気が晴れたのか
findings.governingReading: Inactive narration: perhaps that cleared her mood
findings.explanation: mirror moon restores an inactive tentative inference and strengthens it to “must.”

findings.highlight: Tohsaka seems to have calmed down
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂は溜飲をさげて
findings.governingReading: Inactive narration: Rin’s indignation subsides
findings.explanation: A fifth inactive Japanese narration fragment is presented as active English prose.

findings.evidenceJa: 心臓に悪い状況
findings.governingReading: a situation terrible for my heart
findings.explanation: Shirou’s bodily romantic panic is generalized to inconvenience.

findings.highlight: good at reading what I fear the most
findings.evidenceJa: 恐れている事を読みとるのが得意
findings.governingReading: good at reading my weaknesses and what I fear
findings.explanation: mirror moon adds the superlative “most,” escalating an unranked fear.

findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂は遠坂だ
findings.governingReading: Tohsaka is still Tohsaka
findings.explanation: The first refrain survives, but the following English outburst drops the irrational “even though you’re Tohsaka” premise that makes his panic character-specific.

findings.highlight: if you come into my house
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂なのに俺んちにあがったりしたら
findings.governingReading: if you—Tohsaka of all people—come into my house
findings.explanation: Shirou’s illogical, flustered insistence that Rin specifically cannot enter disappears.

findings.highlight: The intruder, Tohsaka Rin, comes into the house
findings.evidenceJa: ドカドカと上がりこんでくる侵略者
findings.governingReading: the invader stomps her way into the house
findings.explanation: The noisy physical invasion metaphor behind Shirou’s exaggerated resistance is flattened.

findings.highlight: carelessly goes into the living room
findings.evidenceJa: 事も無げに居間へ移動
findings.governingReading: proceeds into the living room as though it were nothing
findings.explanation: Rin’s complete unconcern becomes carelessness or poor judgment.

findings.evidenceJa: 柳洞寺に陣を構えた
findings.governingReading: Caster, who has established her position at Ryuudou Temple
findings.explanation: Caster’s deliberate fortified occupation disappears.

findings.highlight: independent action as his class ability
findings.evidenceJa: 役割的に単独行動が可能
findings.governingReading: whose role/class permits Independent Action
findings.explanation: Only the class-mechanical reading survives; the written-language frame of Archer’s role disappears.

findings.highlight: manage to get in there by force
findings.evidenceJa: 多少の無理は利く
findings.governingReading: can push his limits somewhat
findings.explanation: Saber describes Archer tolerating some strain as an exception; English turns that into the physical method by which he enters.

findings.highlight: after he manages to get in there with all his might
findings.evidenceJa: 疲弊しきった体で境内にあがったら
findings.governingReading: once he reaches the temple grounds utterly exhausted
findings.explanation: The resulting exhaustion that makes Archer vulnerable to ambush disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: そんなのいい的じゃないか
findings.governingReading: Wouldn’t that make him a perfect target?
findings.explanation: The explicit target image setting up Rin’s archer/target word reversal is replaced by generic disapproval.

findings.highlight: she will try to take us down with her
findings.evidenceJa: 私たちごと爆散しかねない
findings.governingReading: she may blow herself apart together with all of us
findings.explanation: The predicted explosive self-destruction mechanism becomes a generic mutual defeat.

findings.evidenceJa: するでしょ、そりゃ
findings.governingReading: Of course she would
findings.explanation: Rin’s immediate categorical agreement becomes a wager or personal estimate.

findings.evidenceJa: 夕方の六時前
findings.governingReading: just before six in the evening
findings.explanation: The meeting’s endpoint shifts forward to the exact hour.

findings.evidenceJa: 外はすっかり茜色
findings.governingReading: everything outside is completely dyed crimson
findings.explanation: An enveloping change in the exterior scene becomes a limited, weaker sky color.

findings.evidenceJa: たらのおろし鍋
findings.governingReading: cod hot pot with grated daikon
findings.explanation: The named dish loses grated daikon and becomes malformed English.

findings.evidenceJa: よっこらしょ、と立ち上がる
findings.governingReading: I rise with a “heave-ho”
findings.explanation: The physical-comic transition into cooking disappears; the later “one side dish” is also generalized to “something.”

findings.evidenceJa: これからうちは夕飯
findings.governingReading: our household is about to have dinner
findings.explanation: The reason Rin’s relaxation is presumptuous is that the household is about to eat; English turns it into collective food preparation.

findings.highlight: I complain with all my might
findings.evidenceJa: せやー、と精一杯の抗議
findings.governingReading: I mount my best protest with a strained “seyaa!”
findings.explanation: The mock-battle cry coloring Shirou’s weak excuse disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 夕飯をご馳走になった後
findings.governingReading: after you treat me to dinner
findings.explanation: Rin’s brazen assumption that Shirou will host and feed her becomes a neutral shared meal.

findings.highlight: letting Caster do whatever she wants for a while
findings.evidenceJa: キャスターに関してはしばらく放置
findings.governingReading: leaving Caster alone for the time being
findings.explanation: Rin’s manipulative binary concerns postponing action against Caster; English expands it to affirmative permission for anything Caster wants.

findings.evidenceJa: 両方とも承知の上
findings.governingReading: I understand both conditions
findings.explanation: Rin explicitly accepts both Shirou’s cooking and the need to handle Taiga; the English singular obscures the pair.

findings.evidenceJa: ぷい、と顔を背けて
findings.governingReading: I turn my face away with a pouty huff
findings.explanation: Shirou’s childish defensive affect disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: いつもの場所にエプロンがない
findings.governingReading: the apron is not in its usual place
findings.explanation: The initial apparent mystery is weakened by an unclear location.

findings.evidenceJa: きょろきょろと周りを見渡す
findings.governingReading: I dart my eyes around, searching the room
findings.explanation: The comically oblivious search while the apron is already on him becomes neutral looking.

findings.evidenceJa: 楽しげに笑う
findings.governingReading: laughs with obvious enjoyment
findings.explanation: Rin’s pleasure in catching Shirou out disappears.

findings.highlight: Speaks with an expression of triumph
findings.evidenceJa: なんて、勝ち誇った顔で言いやがった
findings.governingReading: she says with a triumphant look
findings.explanation: The English is a sentence fragment and loses Shirou’s irritated evaluation of her delivery.
